title: Bio-USD: a convention for biological cells on OpenUSD
description: A convention for carrying a population of biological cells in an OpenUSD stage as a PointInstancer with per-instance primvars, including a Cell Ontology / NCI Thesaurus term per cell for interoperability with single-cell atlases. Adds no prim types; any OpenUSD tool reads it. Includes an optional codeless API schema (BioCellAPI) with UsdProfiles capabilities (OpenUSD 26.08 or later reads them), a validator that also registers with OpenUSD's validation framework on OpenUSD 26.05 or later, example stages, and a converter from PhysiCell / MultiCellDS snapshots. Draft, seeking a second implementation.
